as_told.title: New Year's Eve seance of nine elites with Puharich

related.note: Both describe the first channeling of the Nine at Puharich's group in Maine in 1952. This telling puts it at Dr. Vinod's unexpected trance on his first night, while the story puts it at a séance of nine people on New Year's Eve 1952-53.

plain: Nine people held a seance in Maine around New Year's Eve 1952 to 1953, and it became the start of contact with what they called the Nine, a council of unseen beings. The writer Peter Levenda tells it on two episodes, without naming a source, and links it to Andrija Puharich, Arthur Young and Ruth Forbes Paine Young. In the second telling he adds that the nine people were members of the elite, which would put well-connected people at the heart of a channelled alien contact.
